name: self_hosted_runner_tail_log
description: Read the last N bytes of the runner's --log-file with the shared secret redaction (key=value secrets, sk-ant/Bearer/Basic, URL userinfo, JWTs, and VCS/service PATs — see redact() in src/utils/secretRedaction.ts for the current rule set) applied before the content reaches model context.

bytes.description: How many trailing bytes to read. Default 65536.
